class Base { value: number = 1; }
class Derived extends Base { value?: number = 2; }

class BaseStatic { static value: number = 1; }
class DerivedStatic extends BaseStatic { static value?: number = 2; }

class BaseUndefined { value: number | undefined = 1; }
class DerivedUndefined extends BaseUndefined { value?: number = 2; }

class BaseStaticUndefined { static value: number | undefined = 1; }
class DerivedStaticUndefined extends BaseStaticUndefined { static value?: number = 2; }

class BaseOptional { value?: number; static value?: number; }
class DerivedRequired extends BaseOptional { value = 1; static value = 2; }
